problem: _in_window passes the literal "" instead of key to the reference implementation, so every key shares one bucket and per-key limiting is lost (one client exhausts the quota for all others).

Production module imports reference_impl and calls its private _in_window unbound on self, coupling ratelimit.py to a test-oracle module and its internal state layout instead of keeping the inline implementation.
The change adds no tests; nothing covers multi-key isolation or the t + window expiry boundary, so the key-collapse regression goes undetected.
from collections import deque is now unused after the window logic was removed.
